comparison.objective: Remove a clogged return-grille filter and seat a clean cartridge against the back stop.
comparison.physical_skill: Confined linear extraction and aligned cartridge insertion.
comparison.success_condition: Dirty cartridge passes the mouth plane and clean cartridge is seated within 1.2 cm on x/y/z.
comparison.reason: Tests a slide-swap of large cartridges. The candidate's central tested ability is bimanual impact fracture at four notches plus coil protection and fragment containment. No spec versions were provided.
